decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting draws on the firm's long-standing robust specialist lighting expertise and certified testing facilities, so it can interpret customer feedback in this niche and refine the product, giving it a strong fit with existing knowledge.

As a second-generation general interior luminaire, it builds directly on the firm's core LED and office lighting knowledge, which lets management assimilate market results and improve it through in-house R&D.

The microprismatic pendant was actively promoted as a latest release in 2024 and draws on the firm's proprietary optics and glare-control competence, so it is a well-understood core-adjacent product worth developing further.

The marine searchlight fits the firm's marine specialist lighting know-how, but the sibling HMI searchlight has already been dropped, which signals portfolio rationalisation; it likely stays as the retained (probably LED) variant, with moderate risk of consolidation.
